description: Recent test runs of a project, newest first, each with its outcome (clean, minor, major, failed, stopped, or still queued, running or judging), whether the test passed, its conversations and its major and minor problems. Pass `batch` to follow the runs one run_tests or run_suite call started: 'all_finished' turns true when they are all judged. Filter as Test Results does: by mode, result, a date range (from, to), started by a schedule or by hand, problem category, saved test, schedule or a name search; page with offset. It already holds what you need to compare runs; do not call get_run once per run.

batch.description: Only the runs started together in one launch: the batch_id run_tests or run_suite returned.
batch.title: Batch

category.description: Only runs with a problem in this problem category: its id, as list_problem_categories shows it, or its title.
category.title: Category

from.description: Only what started on or after this moment: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or an ISO date and time, UTC unless it names its offset.
from.title: From

limit.description: Most runs to return, newest first.
limit.title: Limit

mode.description: Only tests of this mode: regular, red_team or bias.
mode.title: Mode

offset.description: Skip this many, for the next page.
offset.title: Offset

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

result.description: Only finished runs with this result: clean (no problem), minor (minor problems only), major (a major problem), not_reviewed (nothing could be judged).
result.title: Result

schedule.description: Only runs this schedule started, by the id list_schedules shows.
schedule.title: Schedule

search.description: Only those whose test name contains this.
search.title: Search

started.description: scheduled for runs a schedule started, manual for the rest.
started.title: Started

status.description: Only runs in this status: pending, running, judging, completed, failed, stopped.
status.title: Status

test.description: Only runs of this saved test, by the id list_tests shows.
test.title: Test

to.description: Only what started on or before this moment: a date (YYYY-MM-DD, the whole day counts) or an ISO date and time, UTC unless it names its offset.
to.title: To

name: list_runs
